sky.qualification: Varuna's sky orientation for its camera; the shared universe draws the visible sky.
sky.sceneRegistrationChain: galactic -> ICRF (J2000 constants) -> body-fixed (IAU pole and prime meridian at the epoch) -> ecliptic presentation frame

provenance.source: JPL Horizons fixed 2026-09-03 epoch. Uses one published pole interpretation, ecliptic longitude 53° ±10° and latitude −64° ±6°, converted with the J2000 mean obliquity for display. The antipodal pole is also allowed; equinox and meridian are display conventions, not a qualified absolute attitude.
provenance.qualification: Computed Varuna Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose.
